entry.summary: Secondary sites say Australians enter Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) visa-free for short stays (about 90 days); Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten use an online ED (embarkation-disembarkation) card before arrival.
